actual: Lane K pass, Cricmax - Home Location. There is no "Lessons" section in Settings — all tabs checked: Users, Services, Pricing Rules, Taxes, Promos, Equipment, Amenities, Tags, Customers, Scheduling, Waivers, Prerequisites, Age groups, Leads, Notifications, Communications, Assistant. The Services tab has only "Lane Rental" and "Cricket Coaching" (Edit form: Name, Description, Booking Type only). The Scheduling tab has only Recurring Booking Window, Utilization Thresholds and Peak Hours. Equipment is a 9-item price-less inventory; Amenities lists one "test" amenity. The coach profile (QA Coach C1 1019, people/coaches/60) and its Edit Profile dialog have no "Own prices for one-to-one lessons" control. Step 7: in the Coach view and the coach's own My Profile page no prices are shown and there is no way to set one — but only because no lesson pricing exists anywhere in the app, so the expected restriction cannot be demonstrated.
expected: Settings > Lessons exists with lesson types; coach profile has "Own prices for one-to-one lessons"; a coach login sees no prices and cannot set one.
steps: Open Settings and list every tab; look for Lessons.
Open Services, Scheduling, Equipment, Amenities and note what each holds.
Open a coach profile and its Edit Profile dialog; look for "Own prices for one-to-one lessons".
Switch to Coach and check the Coach view and My Profile for prices or price controls.
title: QXR-580: no lesson types or coach pricing surface — no Lessons section in Settings, no 'Own prices' on coach profiles
